question: Two circles of radius of 20 cm each intersect each other such that each passes through the centre of the other. What is the length of the common chord?
solution:
Given:

The radius of the circles is 20 cm

Calculation:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/81330b9fa22b9dc3ae184a32efee8872aaa67b0a273be5796646776b7c5a3506.png] 

According to the diagram,

AD = DB

O1O2 = 20

Again O1A = O2A = 20 [Radius of the circle]

∠ADO1 = 90°

O1D = O2D = 20/2 = 10

AD = √(400 - 100)

⇒ √300 = 10√3

AB = 2 × 10√3 = 20√3

∴ The length of the common chord is 20√3 cm
